notes.title: Beach Bounce Remastered Release
notes.content:
We are happy to announce after several months of complete redevelopment after the loss of our original developer Yume no Mikata, that Beach Bounce remastered edition has been completed and is already available on Steam.

The remastered edition includes a completely re-written story by a new writer, with a new more advanced graphical user interface and a better overall development.

In addition to the now completed storyline and additional artwork, the game also now includes a full gallery of images to locate and unlock and 19 different endings to enjoy including good, bad and odd.

Last but not least we have also added ten steam achievements to the game and enabled Cloud Saving.

Warning: All saves from before the games remastered edition will likely no longer work and could cause the game to crash, we recommend deleting any saves within the game (press delete key when hovering mouse over them) and starting over from the beginning.

notes.title: Version 1.35 released
notes.content:
Version 1.35 has now been released this should fix all of the version 1.3 errors that came out, however there have a few scenes which were edited and reorganized in this build.

Therefore it is possible once you upgrade that your game could crash, if this happens it is not a bug, it is happening because the game no longer recognizes the point in the game you are at and cannot work out how to move forward or how to move back to a safe point.

We are sorry this has been necessary but we felt a few scenes were not up to scratch with the rest of the game.

If this rare error does happen to you, the only way to fix it is to either load an earlier save point or restart the game. I am sorry this is needed but it is for the best. Once you have reloaded earlier or restarted you should not see the error again.

Thanks for the patience with this correcting update.

notes.title: Version 1.3
notes.content:
We have now released version 1.3 of Beach Bounce, this adds more improvements to the game:.

- Better Sprite integration for the following scenes.
 = Mineko post work
 = Aiko post work
 = Bad news in the morning.

- Additional dialogue changes have also been made in these same scenes.

[b]N.b. Save Game Errors[/b]
Due to the amount of sprite code (over 2500 lines) that has been added to the scenes and also the removal of some dialogue options, it is possible that loading a saved game that is in one of these scenes could load with an error. If this is the case you may need to restart the game or revert to an earlier save point... This error is extremely rare and so unlikely to occur to the majority.  All "End of episode saves" are not affected by these errors, and the changes made do not affect the overall storyline progression.

- Debug message: w1_d5_phase 0 or 1 was showing at the end of the work scene with Rei. This has been fixed.

- All reported grammar issues have been addressed.

- A new option for second playthroughs has been added which allows players to skip the introductory tour of the resort by Yuuki. Watching the credits or replaying the intro should activate this option on future playthroughs.

- Some code adjustments were made in preparation for the Friday patch release.

[i]If any other bugs arise after this update, they can be reported in the Bug Report section of the community hub discussions area.[/i]

notes.title: Release Date
notes.content:
We are now just ten days away from the release of Beach Bounce episode 1 so we felt we should clarify a few basic parts of the release.

1) Episode 1 only will be available on release.

2) Episode 2 and 3 will be released later as free updates
 - So all owners of Beach Bounce will get all three episodes at no extra cost.

3) On release the game will have two discount levels.
 - Owners of Sword of Asumi will get a loyalty discount of 40% if they order it on steam on the first week of release. Non Sword of Asumi owners will get a 20% discount during the first week of release.

4) Beach Bounce will be $15.99 on Steam on release [i](before discount)[/i]
 - After episode 2 is released the game price will increase to $17.99
 - After episode 3 is released the game price will increase to $19.99
[i]N.b. the earlier you order the game the lower the price will be.[/i]

5) Episodes will be released every two months.
 - Episode 2 will be released as a free update on October 12th 2015
 - Episode 3 will be released as a free update on December 14th 2015

6) The adult edition of the game is available for pre-order on MangaGamer for $17.95
- MangaGamer is offering a 20% discount for pre-orders of the game.
Visit MangaGamer adult version, link is not safe for work:
http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=148

7) An adult patch for Beach Bounce may be available on Steam, however it will not be released until after all three episodes have been completed, released and patched to ensure completely stable.

We hope that answers all your questions on the games launch. We hope to see many people playing the game on Friday 14th August when we officially release and unlock the game on Steam.

notes.title: Version 0.55 Beta
notes.content:
Hey all, two weeks of updates today as we forgot to post patch notes last week, progress is now going very quickly on the games development, as can happen with a second dedicated developer 'Chris' putting time into the game:

Game size increased by 90mb, bringing total game size up to 566mb ish.

 - more scenes are now public, but dialogue only.
 - Day transition and map transition some major improvements
 - Map now contains buttons of the girls for certain events ;)
 - The start of a new game now looks better.
    - No more black screen followed by a white screen.
    - Door transitions ~ Very Japanese
- More dialogue is now available.
- A variety of bug fixes
- 10 new CG scenes added to game build (hence size increase)

So that's about it for now, things are still going smoothly for the August release of the game. And we have about 12 CG scenes left to make.

We have also started work on the Trading Cards and Badge levels for the game. After those are completed we will turn our attention to achievement icons.

notes.title: Beta Version 0.27
notes.content:
Hi all, large beta update today, which is why it was slightly later than expected. This latest update is around 100mb in size, due to changes in artwork and other things...

- Added the entire musical score into the game build
- Finalized day 1's activities, game now runs through to the start of day 2.
- Added in all artwork for all main characters within the game
- Added the first CG scene into the game.
- Replaced 90% of the backgrounds with clearly marked placeholder images
- Also added in backgrounds for all places in the game, ready for replacement as artwork is completed.
- Editing all of the intro into the game so far.
- Edited all of the dialogue to 1 sentence per box instead of multiple sentences to ensure a better reading experience
- Added some additional choices into the current story-line that have larger story effects.
- Added more animations for every character in the game, multiple poses and more facial expressions to suit the scenes of the game.
- Included more music within the intro to suit scenes in a better way.

We have no signed off on the current build dialogue, we therefore are now excepting any grammer or spelling errors you may find in the intro leading up to the end of the first day.

Please feel free to post errors in the intro and day 1 content by posting in the steam hub or on the AJTilley.com Forums.
Make sure you update to version 0.27 on steam and start a new game before you post any errors you see.

Please feel free to post errors in the intro and day 1 content by posting in the steam hub or on the AJTilley.com Forums.
Make sure you update to version 0.27 on steam and start a new game before you post any errors you see.

notes.title: Version 0.24 Beta
notes.content:
We have released version 0.24 today for our beta testers.

This includes more character art, a load of bug fixes and code revisions, more animations, extra scenes and a secret mineko intro scene.

The main announcement is that after consideration we have decided to switch to weekly updates on Fridays from now on. The main reason for this is 3 or 4 days just isn't enough to add a decent amount of content and test it for bugs to ensure it does not crash on opening or later on even.

Anyway so from now on you can expect an update every Friday afternoon/Evening with an update on patch notes.

In addition our main characters are now all completed which means our artist will be beginning work on CG scenes for the game whilst backgrounds continue to be developed and added alongside the event development.

notes.title: Over £8k & pre-orders open via Backerkit
notes.content:
Hi all, Beach Bounce is now in its main beta phase of testing and development, with over £8,000 of pre-orders via Backerkit and Kickstarter. This has now expanded the game from four romance options to seven, including two supernatural endings, multi-girl endings and a variety of other good and bad ends.

We have also got over 45 CG scenes being developed for the game and are continuing to grow. With that in mind our Backerkit pre-orders are now open to everyone, which includes the option for DRM-Free, Steam keys and beta access.

https://beach-bounce.backerkit.com/hosted_preorders

Visit the link above to see the current options.
Pre-orders are open until the 5th April, and all funds raised will go towards further development of the game for release in July.
